name: smartcradle-mobile
description: SmartCradle Android Capacitor wrapper and standalone mobile bundle

scripts.sync:android: node scripts/prepare-mobile.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: node scripts/prepare-mobile.mjs && npx cap sync android && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'gradlew.bat assembleDebug' : './gradlew assembleDebug'; execSync(cmd, { cwd: 'android', stdio: 'inherit' });"
